cost.note: Overlapping rank wall times, not exclusive GPU-hours; scoring_cpu is scorer elapsed, not CPU core seconds. Rank0 loop wall starts after actor/DDP preparation, includes checkpoint publication, and is not complete process wall. Preparation and exact save-through-milestone wall are separate; no exit cost exists while training continues.

limits: Fixed difficult TRAIN population, not DEV/Navtest or the full TRAIN mean.
G8 stochastic policy scores and finite candidate maxima are not single-ODE deployment.
A fresh collection is counted once across four inner updates.
Within-run window changes include scene mix; infer efficacy from matched ODE evaluation.
